clauses.current_legal_basis: U.S. Code release point 119-121 (current through 2026-10-09) prints the order, as amended by EO 11382, EO 12608 and EO 13286 sec. 69, as a note to 10 U.S.C. 2603 with no ending statement (jobs/current-law/output/USC_EO_NOTES.jsonl, heading Ex. Ord. No. 11079); 10 U.S.C. 2603 (jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/usc-t10-s2603.txt, current text) still lets fellowships, scholarships or grants be accepted under regulations prescribed by the President or an individual designated by the President; no eCFR or OFR-catalog ending found through 2026-10-14.
clauses.reason: The clause designates three Secretaries to prescribe regulations under 10 U.S.C. 2603 for acceptance of fellowships, scholarships or grants by members of the armed forces and commissioned officers of the Public Health Service, uniform to the extent practicable. The three amendments substituted the designated officers (Transportation, Health and Human Services, Homeland Security) and are later events; the clause continues amended, and the Code note to 10 U.S.C. 2603 prints it that way. 10 U.S.C. 2603 remains in the Code.

research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 11079 of January 25, 1963, 28 FR 819 (Jan. 29, 1963), held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11079.txt; under 10 U.S.C. 2603 it designates the Secretary of Defense, the Secretary of the Treasury (Coast Guard when not in the Navy) and the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare (Public Health Service officers) to prescribe regulations, as uniform as practicable, for acceptance of fellowships, scholarships or grants. Later instruments (all amendments of the designations): EO 11382 (Nov. 28, 1967) sec. 13 struck Secretary of the Treasury and inserted Secretary of Transportation; EO 12608 (Sept. 9, 1987) substituted Health and Human Services for Health, Education, and Welfare in a list that includes this order; EO 13286 sec. 69 (signed Feb. 28, 2003, effective March 1, 2003 under its sec. 92) struck Secretary of Transportation and inserted Secretary of Homeland Security. Searches of held texts for the number find these orders, the 1989 OFR codification line and the 6 U.S.C. 111 note; OFR catalog notes record amendment by EO 11382, EO 12608 and EO 13286 and none says Revoked or Superseded. The Code note under 10 U.S.C. 2603 prints the amended order. Bounded searches read for coverage: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121 USLM text and notes, citations of the order by number, edition current through 2026-10-09, laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts).
